name: VLM-RobustBench
description: VLM-RobustBench is a comprehensive benchmark evaluating the robustness of vision-language models under 49 types of image corruptions across multiple severity levels, revealing spatial fragility and motivating new robustness evaluation protocols.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is gaining attention in VLM robustness research, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Evaluates VLMs on two complementary benchmarks (MMBench and MMMU-Pro) with diverse corruptions.
